usedFor: HeySummit holds summit attendees, and Memory keeps their details as key-value pairs through the “Memory” action.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: Registrations land in workspace storage as they arrive, giving later steps a lookup of who signed up.

watchOut: “Delete Records” removes records from Workspace Memory, so use it with care after “Ticket Purchased”.
